method: agent review of grammar and unchanged operational meaning
scope: Each candidate is rendered in its full sentence with all other slots at their defaults. Each recorded sentence receives agent review of grammar and preservation of the operational instruction. The deterministic validator checks coverage, approvals and exact text, plus a/an agreement against a finite vocabulary of reviewed initial sounds. Other grammar and semantic judgements remain agent review.
decisions: Calibration and its permitted date, signature, reporting day and the quality file are literal because their former alternatives changed the required operation or record.
The leak sentence has a new frame that accepts each of worthwhile, sensible and prudent. The continuation instruction permits continue and proceed.
Measurements, pass and fail conditions, equipment references and perturbation words remain explicit in the surrounding text.

Blank and further are literal words because their former alternatives required a different indefinite article. The finite article rule rejects those mismatches even when a review entry marks the sentence approved.
